samples.question: The picture is filled with short grey strokes that all have the same length, the same thickness and the same colour. Most of the strokes share one common tilt. Inside a single round patch, and only there, every stroke is turned by 90 degrees to that common tilt. The patch has no outline, no shading and no change of stroke spacing, so it is marked by stroke direction alone. Four coloured dots - red, green, blue and orange - are painted on top of the strokes, and exactly one of them lies inside that patch. Which coloured dot lies inside the patch? Answer red, green, blue or orange.
